objectives.title: Food
objectives.description: To provide complete and balanced nutrition to every Indian i.e. men, women, and children.

objectives.title: Housing
objectives.description: To provide decent housing to every family in India.

objectives.title: Clothing
objectives.description: To ensure that clothing is provided according to the regions.

objectives.title: Roads
objectives.description: Providing roads to every area.

objectives.title: Economy
objectives.description: To establish a better economy than any other country in the world. Seeing that the rupee is worth more than the dollar.

objectives.title: Development
objectives.description: Setting up factories, cottage industries, to export to world countries.

objectives.title: Agriculture
objectives.description: Development of agriculture by making land available and providing new support Assembly Constituencies for a large percentage of India's land area to be cultivated.

objectives.title: Employment
objectives.description: Every single employee working in Government, Private and Contract, Outsourcing, Remuneration, Honorary, Private, Management in India should be regular and get pension and live comfortably after retirement.

objectives.title: Education
objectives.description: Establishing modern education more than any other country in the world. Paying salaries on a regular basis to all teachers and professors and ensuring they receive pensions upon retirement.

objectives.title: Medical Health
objectives.description: Making necessary arrangements to ensure a greater percentage of people are free from illness and ensuring pensions for healthcare workers upon retirement.

objectives.title: Employment
objectives.description: To ensure that all employees (including Asha, Anganwadi teachers, Ayas) working in various sectors receive pensions and live comfortably after retirement.

objectives.title: Water Management and Sanitation
objectives.description: India has 18% of the world's population but only 4% of its water resources. Addressing water stress caused by climate change and monsoon variations.

objectives.title: Internal Security
objectives.description: Strengthening internal security post-2008 Mumbai attacks and addressing hate crimes and communal strife.

objectives.title: Health
objectives.description: KPM Party was the first to acknowledge healthcare as a government responsibility and introduced India's first healthcare scheme.

objectives.title: Religious and Linguistic Minorities
objectives.description: Ensuring the rights of all religious and linguistic minorities as granted by the Indian Constitution.

objectives.title: Infrastructure
objectives.description: Developing roads, railways, ports, airports, and electricity infrastructure to world-class standards.

objectives.title: Media
objectives.description: Ensuring media freedom as per the Indian Constitution.

objectives.title: North Eastern States
objectives.description: Recognizing the pluralism and diversity of the North Eastern states within the Union of India.

objectives.title: Taxation and Tax Reforms
objectives.description: Overhauling India's taxation system to be people-friendly, efficient, and promote investment.

objectives.title: Women's Empowerment
objectives.description: Removing discrimination against women and upholding their rights.

objectives.title: Rural and Urban Development
objectives.description: Addressing the needs of rural and urban areas by providing necessary infrastructure and supporting industrial growth.
